description: This Scala source file defines the ExecutorResourcesAmounts class used in Apache Spark to manage and allocate executor resource amounts such as GPUs and FPGAs. It includes methods for acquiring, releasing, and assigning resources based on resource profiles, and provides utility functions for resource management within Spark's scheduler.

classes.name: ExecutorResourcesAmounts
classes.description: Class to manage resource amounts for an executor, including allocation, release, and address assignment.
